views.definition:
SELECT company_id,
    distributor_id,
    source_key,
    kind,
    event_date,
    amount,
    tax,
    mode,
    bank_id,
    description,
    reference
   FROM ( SELECT c.company_id,
            c.distributor_id,
            'credit:'::text || c.id AS source_key,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.money_transaction_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'RECEIPT'::text
                    ELSE 'PURCHASE'::text
                END AS kind,
            c.created_at AS event_date,
            round(c.amount::numeric, 2) AS amount,
            0::numeric AS tax,
            COALESCE(m.payment_mode::text, 'CASH'::text) AS mode,
            m.account_id AS bank_id,
            COALESCE(c.remarks, ''::text) AS description,
            COALESCE(c."billNo", 'DC-'::text || c.credit_no::text, c.id) AS reference
           FROM distributor_credits c
             LEFT JOIN money_transactions m ON m.id = c.money_transaction_id AND m.company_id = c.company_id
          WHERE c.purchase_order_id IS NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT c.company_id,
            c.distributor_id,
            'purchase:'::text || c.purchase_order_id AS source_key,
            'PURCHASE'::text AS kind,
            min(c.created_at) AS event_date,
            round(sum(c.amount)::numeric, 2) AS amount,
                CASE
                    WHEN round(sum(c.amount)::numeric, 2) = round(max(p.total_amount)::numeric, 2) THEN max(accountant_v2_purchase_tax(p.*))
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS tax,
            NULL::text AS mode,
            NULL::text AS bank_id,
            'Purchase credit'::text AS description,
            COALESCE(max(p.bill_no), 'PO-'::text || max(p.purchase_order_no)::text, c.purchase_order_id) AS reference
           FROM distributor_credits c
             LEFT JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.id = c.purchase_order_id AND p.company_id = c.company_id
          WHERE c.purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY c.company_id, c.distributor_id, c.purchase_order_id
        UNION ALL
         SELECT p.company_id,
            p.distributor_id,
            'purchase:'::text || p.id AS source_key,
            'PURCHASE'::text AS kind,
            p.created_at AS event_date,
            round(p.total_amount::numeric, 2) AS amount,
            accountant_v2_purchase_tax(p.*) AS tax,
            NULL::text AS mode,
            NULL::text AS bank_id,
            'Paid purchase (legacy purchase side missing)'::text AS description,
            COALESCE(p.bill_no, 'PO-'::text || p.purchase_order_no::text, p.id) AS reference
           FROM purchase_orders p
          WHERE p.distributor_id IS NOT NULL AND p.payment_type IS NOT NULL AND p.total_amount <> 0::double precision AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM distributor_credits c
                  WHERE c.purchase_order_id = p.id AND c.company_id = p.company_id)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM distributor_payments dp
                  WHERE dp.purchase_order_id = p.id AND dp.company_id = p.company_id AND dp.distributor_id = p.distributor_id AND dp.payment_type::text <> 'RETURN'::text))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT p.company_id,
            p.distributor_id,
            'payment:'::text || p.id AS source_key,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.payment_type::text = 'RETURN'::text THEN 'RETURN'::text
                    ELSE 'PAYMENT'::text
                END AS kind,
            COALESCE(r.created_at, p.created_at) AS event_date,
            round(p.amount::numeric, 2) AS amount,
            round(COALESCE(r.tax_amount, 0::double precision)::numeric, 2) AS tax,
            COALESCE(p.payment_type::text, 'CASH'::text) AS mode,
            NULL::text AS bank_id,
            COALESCE(p.remarks, ''::text) AS description,
            COALESCE('PR-'::text || r.return_no::text, 'DP-'::text || p.payment_no::text, p.id) AS reference
           FROM distributor_payments p
             LEFT JOIN purchase_returns r ON r.id = p.purchase_return_id AND r.company_id = p.company_id
        UNION ALL
         SELECT d.company_id,
            d.distributor_id,
            'opening'::text AS source_key,
            'OPENING'::text AS kind,
            COALESCE(d.opening_due_date, (( SELECT min(x.created_at) AS min
                   FROM ( SELECT distributor_credits.created_at
                           FROM distributor_credits
                          WHERE distributor_credits.company_id = d.company_id AND distributor_credits.distributor_id = d.distributor_id
                        UNION ALL
                         SELECT distributor_payments.created_at
                           FROM distributor_payments
                          WHERE distributor_payments.company_id = d.company_id AND distributor_payments.distributor_id = d.distributor_id) x)) - '00:00:00.001'::interval, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp without time zone) AS event_date,
            round(COALESCE(d.opening_due, 0::double precision)::numeric, 2) AS amount,
            0 AS tax,
            NULL::text AS mode,
            NULL::text AS bank_id,
            'Distributor opening balance'::text AS description,
            'Opening'::text AS reference
           FROM distributor_companies d
          WHERE COALESCE(d.opening_due, 0::double precision) <> 0::double precision) v
  WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM accountant_v2_accountant_audit a
          WHERE a.company_id = v.company_id AND a.resource = 'authorized-distributor-exclusion'::text AND a.action = 'excluded'::text AND a."resourceId" = ((v.distributor_id || ':'::text) || v.source_key)));
